item.title: Version 2.8.2
item.description:
iPod Drop 2.8.2

  • Recently Added playlist. A live playlist on your iPod with your 50 newest songs, next to Never Played and On Repeat. It's on by default; turn it off in Settings.
  • Pick matches by their cover. In Fix Info, click a match to see every suggestion as a card with its cover art, album, year and length, and pick the right one at a glance.
  • Faster Fix Info. Albums are looked up side by side, and cover art downloads in parallel when you apply.
  • Faster saving of cover art. Changing covers rewrites your iPod's artwork files; iPod Drop now checks them once instead of up to six times, so these saves take about a third of the time.
